title: What a design portfolio proves when polish is cheap
description: When finished-looking work is cheap to produce, design portfolios prove less. Here is how to hire for judgement by asking to see the decisions.

Now that finish is cheap, we argue hiring teams should ask to see the directions a candidate rejected and why. It is a small change to an interview, and it reveals far more about how someone thinks.
